About Marquis II

If you're looking for a fun and vibrant spot to hang out with friends, or just enjoy a casual meal in Houston, Marquis II is the place to be. Located at 2631 Bissonnet St, this restaurant offers the perfect mix of a laid-back atmosphere, delicious food, and a lively vibe that’ll keep you coming back.

The moment you step inside, you’ll be welcomed by the upbeat tunes of the juke box and the lively chatter of fellow patrons. The energy here is contagious, making it ideal for groups looking to unwind and have a good time. Whether you’re there to catch up with friends or celebrate a special occasion, the atmosphere at Marquis II is always upbeat, and the loud vibe only adds to the excitement.

The menu is packed with crowd favorites that will satisfy any craving. For a refreshing start, try the Long Island – it’s the perfect drink to get you in the mood for a good time. If you're in the mood for something tropical, the Island Punch will transport you straight to a beachside paradise. And for a classic choice, the Arnold Palmer is a simple but flavorful hit.

One of the best things about Marquis II is its outdoor seating area. Whether you're enjoying happy hour specials or just taking in the fresh air, the outdoor space makes it an excellent choice for those looking to enjoy a meal or drinks in a relaxed, open environment. And with happy hour specials on offer, you’ll get great deals without sacrificing quality.

Marquis II is not just about the food and drinks—it’s about the experience. With ample space for groups, it’s the ideal spot to kick back, enjoy some great tunes, and savor tasty dishes with a fun crowd. If you’re in Houston and looking for a place where you can let loose, Marquis II definitely delivers.

Reviews

“ Cool bar. I drive by this place weekly and have never stopped in until this past Friday to watch that insufferable UT game. Decent amount of parking although the spots are narrow. Very chill vibe inside with a large bar, lots of seating and large screen tvs everywhere with surround sound. The bar tenders are friendly and attentive. There is some limited outdoor seating and they also serve pizza. This is a cool local bar to check out if you want to grab a drink or watch a game. ”

Char I.

“ I've been going here for a few years now! Tea's Tuesdays were a big thing when I was 21, everyone wanted to come here! The bar used to be super packed on Tuesdays, to the point where you were body to body with people. Nowadays, the place is a lot more quiet, but still has the great teas Tuesdays deal (remember only 2 per person!). Service is always good and they are never rude here! Definitely stop by on a random Tuesday for some fun! ”

Jeremy D.

“ Great place to hang out with friends. I can't wait to take my husband there for a date! pull table and darts excellent service! nice people around! good location. 10/10 ”

Gabriela M.

“ Best bar ever! Service is top notch! The atmosphere is amazing l! Great neighborhood bar ”

Erika A.

“ Great space with very relaxed ambiance. Awesome service and very friendly bartenders. ”

Ili C.

“ My boyfriend and I LOVE this bar! I always request to go here when we decide to go out and it is so fun every time. My favorite aspect is the one bartender who is always there when we go--I completely forgot his name but he has worn a cap hat the few times we've gone. He is AWESOME. So welcoming, kind, and just great energy to be around. We will definitely be back soon. ”

Joanna Q.

“ Cocktail drinks above any others around locally. Service is amazing as well, was asked by two bartenders if I needed anything as the first was already serving my order. Taylor is great and has great drink recommendations. Stop by if you're lookijg to relax or play darts/pool. They are on opposite sides of the bar so you won't feel crowded at all here. Thank you all at Marquis II, I appreciate you. ”

Dominik P.

“ Had to come out here to try their famous TX Tea... wow. Y'all, there's a reason they have a 2-tea limit.. this stuff is strong. Don't get me wrong, it does taste pretty good, but there's no doubt it's fully loaded :) We ordered at the bar and took a few seats on the nearby couch. We found some fun games in a stack and ended up grabbing one that had cards with random questions that we then asked each other and laughed at while drinking these teas. What a simple, but fun idea to have some old-school games in the bar! We also played a couple rounds of billards - bring your quarters if you want to play, it's only $1 but takes quarters. Our bartender (I think her name was Jordan) was really nice and quick on getting us served. The ambiance inside is a neighborhood bar. I have the feeling if we went often they would know us by name pretty quickly - everyone we interacted with was just very friendly. I was hoping to meet the Owner because I see him on IG sometimes with his videos and random polls, but he wasn't there during our short visit (in fairness, we were not there very long). so... I'll just have to come again! ”

Jen S.
